memories.text: The ACOS gateway uses FastAPI framework with SQLAlchemy for database operations and SQLite for local storage.
API keys are configured through environment variables prefixed with ACOS_ such as ACOS_PREMIUM_API_KEY and ACOS_CHEAP_API_KEY.
The exact cache stores LLM responses keyed by SHA-256 hash of the normalized prompt and supports configurable TTL.
The rule router classifies requests into cheap or premium categories using keyword matching and regex patterns.
The rolling context summarizer caps conversation history at 800 tokens using simulated or LLM-based summarization.
